'''Halverson''' (Japanese: '''ハクア''' ''Hakua'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP124|To Thine Own Pokémon Be True!]]''.

Halverson was one of the participants in the [[Pokémon Ping Pong Tournament]] with his {{p|Marowak}}. Their first opponent was [[Jessie]], who was partnered with {{MTR}}. Halverson and Marowak won by default after Jessie's disqualification and moved on to the second round. They would go on to be defeated by {{an|Dawn}} and {{TP|Dawn|Ambipom}} in the third round.
